query:
SELECT u.id as user_id, u.name, u.friendCode, d.id as twin_id, d.name as twin_name, d.mbtiType->'$.type' as mbti
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN digital_twins d ON u.id = d.userId
WHERE u.openId LIKE 'test_user_%'
ORDER BY u.id;
